validations_executed.evidence: Cases no longer link out to the live site; each shows a verify status inline. Home Depot severe pairs were live-reverified via the browser (drywall 2411->2410, sheetrock 33->33, liquid nails 17->17, quikrete 643->637, roundup 249->251) — all confirmed within tolerance.

Each case renders a colored severity dot, muted term counts, a delta %, and a green check/red cross verify chip; expand shows plain evidence rows (term -> N results) and a Confirmed line. Panel header shows the confirmed count.
The icon+verify renderer reads case.verify/verdict/term totals generically, so future datasets (e.g. dimensions) render the same way.
